correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the invariant one-time marginal from the linear Volterra marginal equation and the equilibrium initial law, hence E[f]=0 and E[f^2]=v. For J_t=int_0^t f(X_s)ds, the continuous additive functional and jump/Dynkin product rule give S'=2C and C'=v-(lambda+r)C+(r/t)S, with S=E[J^2], C=E[Jf(X_t)]; no stationarity of full paths was assumed. The resulting singular ODE S''+(lambda+r)S'-(2r/t)S=2v has regular solution S=vt^2 sum_{n>=0} [(2-p)_n/((2)_n(3)_n)]*(-at)^n; coefficient recurrence and initial normalization checked. Beta(2-p,1+p) has moments (2-p)_n/(3)_n and positive shapes for all finite r>=0, lambda>0; this proves the exact Beta formula. Inverse moment E[1/B]=2/(1-p) for p<1, Beta(1,2) endpoint log at p=1, and the Mellin endpoint integral Gamma(2-p)/(p-1) for 1<p<2 give all three sharp coefficients and powers. Five independent 40-digit quadratures matched the prior Kummer forms, including r=0 and critical p=1; reconstructed Git tree from the seven independently read Git blob identities exactly equals assigned SHA 12775a68344d961ec110ed1644b896137fbbb20e. The analytic argument, not these finite checks, proves all times and long-time limits. The statement explicitly assumes valid integrability and Dynkin product identities, excluding pathological generator domains.

value.rationale: The equilibrium-with-anomalous-averaging phenomenon, exact finite-time variance and all three sharp phase laws already appear in the earlier 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-02 published OU works. Although spectral generalization to arbitrary real eigenobservables is a natural framing, the submitted final formula is obtained from the published two-moment proof by the sole replacement Lx=-mu*x to Lf=-lambda*f; the assumed Dynkin identities do the remaining work. No new nontrivial structural lemma, new example with different qualitative behavior, composite spectrum, or independent invariant is established. The Beta representation is a standard transform of the prior Kummer formula. This narrow routine generalization lacks a substantively new mathematical result under the same value bar, irrespective of its correctness and reproducibility.

final_claim: For any equilibrium-initialized conservative Markov diffusion with an L²-real generator eigenobservable f of eigenvalue -lambda<0 and variance v>0, uniform-past Poisson relocation at rate r>=0 preserves its one-time equilibrium law. The ensemble variance of its physical-time average is exactly v/(at)*E[(1-e^{-atB})/B] with a=lambda+r, B~Beta(2-p,1+p), p=2r/a, and has exact inverse-time, critical log/time, or t^(p-2) asymptotics according as r<lambda, r=lambda, or r>lambda. Under the stated Dynkin product hypotheses only, no CLT or full path stationarity is claimed.
limitations: The theorem requires equilibrium initialization, a nonzero real L² eigenobservable with lambda>0, finite r and valid Dynkin product identities; no non-eigenobservable, nonuniform memory kernel or time-average distribution law is established.
Full path stationarity does not follow from stationary one-time marginals; do not conflate these.
The proof is correct but the main finding is a mechanically generalized, already solved OU spectral-time-average law, so scientific rejection is due to originality/value rather than invalidity.
Primary 2024 2405.10283 full text could not be read, but three earlier directly matching full-text published theorems were reviewed; their priority dominates.
